skills.name: baseline-variance
skills.title: Baseline variance
skills.description: Variance of a project against its baseline (or another project): finish variance, slipped activities, link changes and SPI. Use when the user asks to compare a project with its baseline or with another version.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: delay-whatif
skills.title: Delay what-if
skills.description: What-if impact of delaying one activity: driving path, float origin and the effect on the project finish and milestones (nothing is written). Use when the user asks what happens if an activity is late or delayed.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: export-dashboard
skills.title: Excel dashboard
skills.description: Excel project controls dashboard of a project (one A3 page and detail sheets), then a short summary of its figures (the database is never written). Use when the user asks for an Excel dashboard or a one-page project report.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: list
skills.title: List projects by EPS
skills.description: List the projects of the database grouped by EPS, with status, data date and finish.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: lookahead-brief
skills.title: Look-ahead brief
skills.description: Short look-ahead of a P6 project: what starts, finishes and is in progress in the next weeks, critical work first. Use when the user asks what is coming up or for a short-term plan.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: schedule-quality-audit
skills.title: Schedule quality audit
skills.description: DCMA 14 quality audit of a project with trend, dangling ends, redundant links and float profile; fixes proposed as dry runs only. Use when the user asks to audit, check or score the quality of a schedule.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: update-import-safely
skills.title: Update import (safe)
skills.description: Import an updated XER into an existing project safely: inspect, dry run, review, then apply only on the user's yes. Use when the user wants to import or load an XER update into a project.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: weekly-update-review
skills.title: Weekly update review
skills.description: Weekly schedule update review of a project: progress, critical path, status issues, look-ahead and baseline variance. Use when the user asks for a weekly update review, a status report or how a project is progressing.
skills.author: nizarhamza
